question: Should Control UI add a separate expanded composer modal, continue refining the inline composer/autogrow pattern, or treat the recent composer redesign and send-shortcut setting as enough?
rationale: Current main has partial long-prompt ergonomics but not the requested modal; choosing between a new modal surface and further inline refinement is a UX/product decision, not a deterministic bug fix.

options.title: Keep open for composer UX decision
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Control UI long-prompt composer request until maintainers choose modal versus inline refinement.

options.title: Declare current inline behavior sufficient
options.body: Close this manually if maintainers decide the redesigned inline composer and configurable send shortcut satisfy the product need.

options.title: Implement modal as a focused feature
options.body: Sponsor a focused PR for an expanded editor modal with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, and keyboard/focus tests.

recommendation.title: Keep open for composer UX decision
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Control UI long-prompt composer request until maintainers choose modal versus inline refinement.
